steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Once upon a time, there was a peaceful city that suddenly came under attack by a mysterious monster! This monster wreaked havoc everywhere, plunging the whole city into chaos.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The monster had dark blue hair, and when it got angry, it emitted an eerie light. People called it... "Starzilla."

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... Feels like I've seen this monster somewhere before.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But in this critical moment, a hero rose up to save the city. Her name is... Super Lion!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Wow! Super Lion is so awesome!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's right! Super Lion upholds justice and would never let any villain get away!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The monster was a fierce and cunning opponent who pushed Super Lion to the brink every time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But at the last minute, Super Lion always uses her Ultimate "Lion Light Cannon" to turn the tide of battle!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: "Lion Light Cannon" to the rescue! Pew... pew... pew...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey, you got hit by the Lion Light Cannon. Fall down quickly...
You pretend to get knocked down by the Lion Light Cannon. The girl giggles in glee.
You ignore the girl's childish antics. OwO looks at you and pouts, disgruntled.
